status: Twenty new candidates, C141–C160, were rendered and individually reviewed. C160 combines softer smile relief, lips that merge into the skin, rounded dental surfaces, subtle nasal linings, strand-varying hair roughness and a closer temple/crown fit. Ten selected-model views were rendered. The campaign now has 160 reviewed candidates; the 95-point visual target is not yet met.

iterations.title: First complete model and five-view review
iterations.notes: Recognizable clothing and stance, but scalp intersections, terraced contours, covered neckline and overbright skin prevent a credible likeness. Target not reached.

iterations.title: Continuous contours and clean scalp coverage
iterations.notes: Terraced body contours and scalp holes are corrected. The neckline is open and shading is cleaner. Shoulder width, wide-eyed expression, hair shape and detached-looking straps still need refinement.

iterations.title: Proportion and expression correction
iterations.notes: Shoulders are narrower, hands no longer protrude in front, the scalp is rounded and irises are bounded by eyelids. The face remains stylized; hair clumps, rigid backpack and floating strap hardware still need work.

iterations.title: Hair, bag, hand pose and shoe refinement
iterations.notes: The backpack and clasped-hand composition are better, but the forearm loft flattened under the new pose. Collar-band intersections and the lower lip need correction. These regressions are explicitly retained in the review record.

iterations.title: Round forearms and continuous swept fringe
iterations.notes: Forearms now retain round cross-sections and the collar no longer forms large tie-band loops. Fine fringe fibers create shadow speckling and the tooth row projects too far forward. Photographic likeness remains approximate.

iterations.title: Static mesh batching and first GLB validation
iterations.notes: Geometry was reduced to 39 meshes and 77 measured draw calls; the GLB validates with zero errors or warnings. Fringe artifacts remain despite shadow changes, and the unsupported bump extension must be replaced for portability. Likeness is still approximate.

iterations.title: Portable materials and artifact cleanup
iterations.notes: Fringe speckling is removed and the unsupported bump extension is gone. Export validation and viewer controls pass, but visual inspection caught an inward-facing dental surface; this regression lowers the score and must be fixed before publication.

iterations.title: Clean fringe and repaired smile
iterations.notes: The inverted tooth surface is fixed and the fringe no longer has intersecting fibers. Front, side, back, face and mobile views are coherent. The face is still a stylized approximation rather than a close photographic likeness; fine hair and garment realism remain below target.

iterations.title: Lower-face proportions and exported-model inspection
iterations.notes: The face has less exaggerated eye width and a shorter chin; the clothes and silhouette are coherent from the reviewed angles. This remains a 70/100 stylized study, not a 95+ photographic likeness. Remaining priorities are facial anatomy, hair realism, garment drape and measured real-device performance.

iterations.title: Material-faithful GLB and final checkpoint review
iterations.notes: The independent GLB now matches geometry, material factors and cloth appearance. Degenerate triangles and unsupported material extensions are removed. The model remains a 70/100 stylized study: facial likeness, fine hair and garment realism still fall short of the requested 95+ target.

iterations.title: Shared facial surface evaluator
iterations.notes: Eyes and lip attachments now use the same curved surface evaluator as the head. The correction is technically important but does not justify raising the visual score; the eye outlines, smooth cheeks and hair still look too stylized.

iterations.title: Integrated eye detail and portrait lighting
iterations.notes: The new eye surfaces remove the earlier detached outline rings, but the upper eyelid is too raised and the brows are too sparse. This revision does not yet improve the overall visual score.

iterations.title: Face proportion and eyelid corrections
iterations.notes: The face is less compressed and the eyebrow density is improved. A color mismatch between the eyelid patches and the head remains visible, so the visual score stays at 70 while that seam is corrected.

iterations.title: Directional hair materials and fuller layers
iterations.notes: The hair has clearer strand direction, fuller ponytails and slightly asymmetric lengths. Full-body readability improves. Closeups still reveal a hard center seam on the face and a faint eyelid boundary, so the model remains well below the 85 target.

iterations.title: Continuous facial shading and blended eyelids
iterations.notes: The hard vertical facial seam is removed, and the eyelid patches now meet the surrounding skin without the earlier visible rim. The smile and nose detail remain too schematic, and the stance still needs closer matching.

iterations.title: Smile proportions and nostril contours
iterations.notes: The wider smile and crescent nostril contours read more clearly, but the continuous dental band still looks artificial. The score is unchanged until tooth separation and the relaxed stance are improved.

iterations.title: Relaxed stance and individual teeth
iterations.notes: The closer, offset feet and bent-knee stance are more faithful to the reference. Individual teeth replace the white band, although the gaps need softer shading. The neck and collar remain too compressed, and the fringe root still needs blending.

iterations.title: Open neckline and softer dental shading
iterations.notes: The lowered collar and shoulder construction reveals the neck more naturally, and the dark tooth gaps are reduced. The overall shape is clearer, but face and garment realism still fall short of 85.

iterations.title: Relaxed garment drape with attached trim
iterations.notes: The accepted cloth deformation removes the jagged waistband and gives the shirt a more natural fall. Front and profile views remain coherent, and the attached shirt trim follows the cloth. Facial likeness and the swept fringe are still the largest gaps.

iterations.title: Swept fringe and smile-fold experiment
iterations.notes: The asymmetric fringe is closer in direction, but it overlaps the outer eye and exposes an unwanted cap boundary. This is a visual regression and the score is reduced while the hairline is corrected.

iterations.title: Corrected asymmetric hairline
iterations.notes: The eye overlap and intrusive cap boundary are corrected. The swept fringe now frames the face more coherently, while the accepted cloth and stance remain intact. The face is still a stylized interpretation rather than a close photographic likeness.

iterations.title: Curved collar construction and export audit
iterations.notes: The collar surfaces are smoother and the nose detail is less flat. The visual score is unchanged. The export audit caught three invalid tangent vertices, which must be corrected before this model is published.

iterations.title: Recessed eye surfaces and valid tangent bases
iterations.notes: The eyes now sit in recessed sockets instead of simply following the face curvature. The GLB validates cleanly, but the iris highlights are too broad, so the visual score is unchanged until the glare is reduced.

iterations.title: Balanced eye reflections and reviewed cloth checkpoint
iterations.notes: The excessive iris glare is reduced, the smile is more balanced, and the garment, stance and hair corrections remain coherent across the reviewed views. This is an 80/100 stylized model checkpoint, not the requested 85/100 likeness target.

iterations.title: Portable reflections and normal-map export
iterations.notes: The intended hair and eye reflections now use standard exported material factors, and the directional normal strength is baked into the texture. The GLB validates cleanly. The model remains at 80/100; the requested 85 target is not claimed.

iterations.title: Selected head, eye and lip proportion refinement
iterations.notes: Eight distinct new design candidates were rendered and individually reviewed. C8 combines the better neck exposure, softer nasal bridge, calmer eye whites and lip transition. The new campaign target is at least 100 visual candidates and 95/100; it has not been reached.

iterations.title: Forty reviewed candidates and repaired layered hair
iterations.notes: The selected C40 restores physical hair shading, adds restrained strand breakup, curves the nape and keeps the improved head, smile and ear geometry. Forty distinct new candidates have been rendered and individually reviewed; the current 100-candidate and 95/100 targets are still unmet.

iterations.title: Sixty-four reviewed candidates and validated garment checkpoint
iterations.notes: The selected C64 combines the revised eye and nose anatomy, restrained skin treatment, slimmer sleeves, tapered tie knot and more natural collar lay. Sixty-four distinct campaign candidates have been individually reviewed. The current 95/100 visual target has not been achieved.

iterations.title: One hundred reviewed candidates and validated C100 checkpoint
iterations.notes: The campaign has 100 individually reviewed edit-and-render candidates with 216 distinct evidence images. C100 retains the improved face proportions, clothing, closed wrists, low loafers and reduced-density geometry. Its subjective visual score is 88.5/100; the requested 95-point target remains unmet.

iterations.title: Forty additional reviewed candidates and validated C140 continuation
iterations.notes: The campaign now contains 140 individually reviewed edit-and-render candidates. C140 combines a continuous crown/fringe shell, revised smile relief and skin contrast, face-focused mesh sampling, a recessed dental arch and tapered backpack contact. The main export and seven standard/detail views pass validation. The visual target remains unmet at a subjective 90/100.

iterations.title: Integrated facial surfaces and finer crown shading
iterations.notes: Twenty new candidates, C141–C160, were rendered and individually reviewed. C160 combines softer smile relief, lips that merge into the skin, rounded dental surfaces, subtle nasal linings, strand-varying hair roughness and a closer temple/crown fit. Ten selected-model views were rendered. The campaign now has 160 reviewed candidates; the 95-point visual target is not yet met.
